_about: Low-stakes adjustment layer, applied on top of the baseline charts when 'Low-stakes adjustments' is on. 'pool' changes how opponents play; 'hero' changes what is recommended to you. Each rule moves a share ('scale') of the 'from' action's weight to the 'to' action for the listed hands. 'spot' matches chart names: rfi, vsOpen, vs3bet, vs4bet, squeeze, cold4bet, vsJam, vsLimp.

pool.hands: A5s-A2s, K9s, K5s, Q9s, J8s, 76s, 65s, 54s, KJs, AJs, KQs, AQo
pool.note: They 3-bet light less and flat more.

pool.hands: 88-22, ATs-A6s, KTs, QTs, J9s, 87s, 76s, 65s, AJo, KQo
pool.note: They call 3-bets too wide with speculative hands.

hero.note: Low-stakes 4-bets are value-heavy, so fold more of your marginal hands.
Low-stakes 3-bets are value-heavy, so 4-bet bluff less.
